business_summary: Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. provides security services in Japan. The company operates through Security Business, and Building Management and Real Estate Business segments. The company offers on-site security, including facility security, fire and disaster prevention safety management, and VIP personal protection services; mechanical security, such as online and home security; and transport security consisting of security, escort and transportation services for cash, valuables, etc., as well as sells non-life insurance products linked to mechanical security contracts. It also sells and installs surveillance cameras and image monitoring systems; access control systems; and installation and sales of security, fire prevention, and disaster prevention equipment and facilities. Further, the company provides image analysis VACS system, image browsing system, SecurityPlatform ladder, CSP security robot, drone services, Biz Guard S and Biz Guard Revo office security, access control system centrics, apartment security safe room, NEW HiSCT total apartment security, intercom renewal service, unmanned reception system for apartment buildings, AED, safety confirmation service, CSP life support mail, camera malfunctioning monitoring, transport security, comprehensive building management, insurance, mobile emergency reporting system, cyber-attack countermeasures, pest repellent device, and fire hose reel. It also engages in real estate leasing services. It serves hotel, sports gym, coworking spaces, unmanned stores, logistics facilities, small office, building, nursery schools and kindergartens, clinic, restaurant, station, railway depots and substations, apartment, urban commercial facilities, suburban commercial facilities, stadium, factory, and shrines and temples. Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 보안 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 보안 사업, 건물 관리 및 부동산 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 시설보안, 화재 및 방재 안전관리, VIP 개인보호 서비스 등 현장 보안을 제공합니다. 온라인 및 홈 보안과 같은 기계적 보안; 현금, 귀중품 등의 보안, 호송, 운송 서비스로 구성된 운송보안 사업을 비롯하여 기계적 보안계약과 연계된 손해보험 상품을 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 감시 카메라와 이미지 모니터링 시스템을 판매 및 설치합니다. 접근 제어 시스템; 보안, 화재예방, 방재 장비 및 시설의 설치 및 판매 등을 하고 있습니다. 또한, 영상분석 VACS 시스템, 영상 브라우징 시스템, SecurityPlatform 래더, CSP 보안로봇, 드론 서비스, Biz Guard S 및 Biz Guard Revo 사무실 보안, 출입통제 시스템 중심, 아파트 보안 금고, NEW HiSCT 아파트 종합 보안, 인터폰 갱신 서비스, 아파트 무인 접수 시스템, AED, 안전 확인 서비스, CSP life su 등을 제공하고 있습니다.
